title: Policy Inspector + Retention Sandbox for request artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a self-service 'Policy Inspector' and 'Retention Sandbox' in the Console that lets tenants author or select retention rules for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics and preview exact artifacts that would be retained, sampled, or purged. The feature should produce deterministic sample exports and a signed evidence bundle preview to satisfy audits without requiring full data grabs. Focus on tenant-scoped rules, region-aware residency, and explainable rule evaluation for legal/audit stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new Retention Sandbox page that accepts a set of retention rules and a date range and returns a preview summary of matched artifact counts by type (prompts, responses, request logs, metrics)
Policy Inspector explains rule precedence and shows which rule matched each example artifact with a human-friendly justification string
Export: sandbox can generate an evidence preview (metadata-only) and a sampled artifact bundle (PII redacted option) with deterministic sampling seed and signed manifest
API: retention-eval endpoint (internal) returns decision for an artifact with trace of rule evaluation within 200ms p50 and <= 600ms p95 for single artifact checks
Docs: developer docs and quick tutorial demonstrating how to use sandbox to validate tenant policies and produce an evidence bundle for SOC/Legal
Security: KMS/HSM integration for signing evidence manifests and audit log entries for all sandbox exports
implementation_notes: Backend: implement a retention-eval microservice that loads tenant policy graph and returns match result + matched_rule_id + explanation; reuse existing policy DSL where possible
Sampling: deterministic reservoir sampling per-tenant per-time-window; expose seed in manifest and allow replay in retention simulator
UI: two-mode flow — (1) quick preview with aggregated counts, (2) artifact explorer showing example prompt/response/request log rows with match rationale
Data: do not access full plaintext during preview exports unless tenant toggles explicit 'include-plaintext' and verifies in UI; require admin role
Observability: add console metrics for eval latency, sandbox exports, and sample rates; wire to per-tenant cost estimate card
Residency: sandbox runs should respect tenant region selection; when previewing cross-region rules, clearly surface residency conflicts and recommended mitigations
Compliance: provide downloadable signed manifest with hash chain so legal can verify provenance of sample bundle
Scale: prioritize p95 latency for single-artifact evals and design batch-eval for preview windows up to 10k artifacts without blocking UI
comments: 2026-02-16 - Maya Chen: Spoke with Legal (A. Rivera). They need manifest signatures and a redaction checklist. Legal requested a non-PII metadata-only export option for initial audits.

2026-02-23 - Liam O'Connor: Technical spike completed. Backend eval service prototype returns rule traces and explanation strings. Perf looks good p50=34ms, p95=190ms for single artifact in dev environment.
2026-03-01 - Design: added early explorer mocks (link in docs). Key feedback: inspectors must show 'why' a rule matched (tokenized snippet + clause hit).
2026-03-05 - PM: Decided to defer full plaintext export behind admin consent and consent audit trail. Added security_review_required flag and KMS signing requirement.

2026-03-09 - Engineering: flagged dependency on existing snapshot export service (ENG-22456) for large-window previews. Proposed optimization: preview only includes metadata and 0-100 sample artifacts by default.
2026-03-10 - PM: Updated acceptance criteria to require deterministic sampling seed and signed manifest. Preparing RFC for next cycle to cover multi-tenant performance constraints.
